blurb: Guests rent various types of bikes to explore Maui's scenic paths, towns, coastlines, and trails at their own pace. Rentals include cruisers, hybrids, mountain bikes, e-mountain bikes, road bikes, and e-road bikes. Locations include Paia, Kihei, and Kapalua with options for delivery and transfers.
